message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes about **6 hours** on the I‑5 corridor under normal conditions. The route covers roughly 380–400 miles (≈610–640 km). Keep in mind that rush hour, construction, or weather can add extra time, so plan accordingly.
